hooks.command: SESSION_FILE="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/sessions/last-session.json"; [ -f "$SESSION_FILE" ] && F="$SESSION_FILE" python3 -c "import json,os,time; f=os.environ['F']; d=json.load(open(f)); age=int((time.time()-os.path.getmtime(f))/60); b=d.get('branch','?'); uc=d.get('uncommitted_count',0); rc=d.get('recent_commits',''); parts=['branch='+b]; uc and parts.append(str(uc)+' uncommitted file(s)'); rc and parts.append('commits: '+rc.replace('|',', ')); print(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'Last session '+str(age)+'min ago — '+', '.join(parts)+'.'}))" 2>/dev/null || true

mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/sessions" && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) && DIRTY_COUNT=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ' || echo 0) && DIRTY_FILES=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | head -20 | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//') && RECENT=$(git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//') && OPEN_PRS=$(gh pr list --state open --json number,title --jq '[.[0:5][] | "#" + (.number|tostring) + ": " + .title] | join(", ")' 2>/dev/null || echo '') && BRANCH="$BRANCH" DIRTY="$DIRTY_COUNT" FILES="$DIRTY_FILES" RECENT="$RECENT" PRS="$OPEN_PRS" ENDED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" python3 -c "import json,os; d={'ended_at':os.environ.get('ENDED',''),'branch':os.environ.get('BRANCH',''),'uncommitted_count':int(os.environ.get('DIRTY','0') or 0),'changed_files':[x for x in os.environ.get('FILES','').split(',') if x],'recent_commits':os.environ.get('RECENT',''),'open_prs':os.environ.get('PRS','')}; print(json.dumps(d))" > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/sessions/last-session.json" 2>/dev/null || true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git status --short 2>/dev/null | { read -r line; if [ -n "$line" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Warning: uncommitted changes exist. Consider committing before ending the session."}'; fi; } || true

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$file" in *ruff.toml|*tsconfig.json|*.eslintrc*|*tailwind.config.*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Config protection: edits to quality gate files require explicit user approval. State what you want to change and why."}}' ;; *pyproject.toml) changed=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); ti=d.get('tool_input',{}); print(ti.get('old_string','') + ti.get('new_string','') + ti.get('content',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$changed" | grep -qE '\[tool\.(ruff|mypy|pylint)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Config protection: edits to [tool.ruff] or [tool.mypy] in pyproject.toml require explicit user approval."}}'; fi ;; esac || true

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'origin\s+(main|master)\b|(main|master)\s*$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct push to main/master is blocked. Create a feature branch and open a PR instead."}}'; fi || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" 2>/dev/null && ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null && ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" 2>/dev/null && npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; } || true

hooks.statusMessage: Checking if PR needs to be created...

hooks.command: COUNTER_FILE="/tmp/claude_tool_count_${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$$}"; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); COUNT=$((COUNT + 1)); echo "$COUNT" > "$COUNTER_FILE"; if [ $((COUNT % 40)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Tool call #$COUNT reached. Consider running /compact now to preserve context quality.\"}"; fi || true

BRANCH=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); COUNTER_FILE="/tmp/claude_tool_count_${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$$}"; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Compacting at tool call ~$COUNT on branch $BRANCH. After compaction: agency_id on every query, CAST(:x AS jsonb), structlog only, compliance before every call.\"}"

echo '{"systemMessage": "Context compacted. Critical reminders: 1) JSONB mutation: always reassign whole dict. 2) asyncpg: CAST(:param AS jsonb) never ::jsonb. 3) agency_id filter on every query. 4) structlog only, never print(). 5) AI disclosure + consent before every call. 6) ATS credentials Fernet-encrypted. 7) Never log PII or transcripts."}'

BRANCH=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent context — VoiceHire: multi-tenant voice AI SaaS for staffing agencies. FastAPI+SQLAlchemy backend, Next.js+TypeScript frontend. Retell.ai for voice, ATSProvider ABC for ATS. Rules: agency_id on every query, CAST(:x AS jsonb), structlog not print(), compliance (AI disclosure + consent). Current branch: $BRANCH.\"}"

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git status --short 2>/dev/null | { read -r line; if [ -n "$line" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Task complete — uncommitted changes exist. Commit them before moving to the next task."}'; fi; } || true
